justification: Audit run8 (2026-10-16) found Warringah DCP 2011 Part F1 requirement 13 ('The Strand, Dee Why') served to a Brookvale E3 house. Part F1 requirements 11-15 each name one centre; F2 is the Brookvale Brickworks site (Lots 11 and 12 DP 1101677); F3/F4 name individual special-use sites. None has an outline, so all 21 are withheld under the 2026-10-15 rule and listed. F1 general requirements 1-9 stay served: their zone scope is declined on purpose in northern_beaches_config (B1/B2 retired).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the served count for the Warringah selector drifts from expect=994, or any listed row is back on a council-wide layer
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Dry run 2026-10-16 before apply: 'northern_beaches/warringah-dcp-2011-full: served 994, to withhold 21'. After apply: 0 to withhold.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Warringah DCP 2011 PDF p90-94: F1 'Applies to land zoned B1 or B2'; requirements 11-15 headed by centre names; F2 'This control applies to land known as the Brookvale Brickworks (Lots 11 and 12 in DP 1101677)'

pre_impl.existing_data: Part F rows tagged v2_dcp_part F, zones config_declined
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: assumed Part F was zone-wide only; it mixes zone-wide and single-centre requirements
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: 21 ids added to an existing selector

functions.name: main
functions.input: the served rows each listed selector matches in production
functions.output: the 21 Part F named-place rows withheld
functions.if_none: prints nothing to change and writes nothing

break_it.scenario: a general F1 requirement is withheld by mistake
break_it.what_happens: a zone-wide centre control disappears for every Warringah centre house
break_it.how: only requirements whose own first words name a centre or site were listed, read row by row

break_it.scenario: F1 general requirements still reach R2 houses
break_it.what_happens: centre controls shown to non-centre houses
break_it.how: stated decision in northern_beaches_config Part F (zone codes retired); recorded as residual

break_it.scenario: the notice file drifts from the list
break_it.what_happens: the site names the wrong withheld chapters

mutation_analysis: Removing the 21 ids restores 'to withhold 21' in the dry run.
residual_risk: F1 general requirements 1-9 are shown to every Warringah house until B1/B2 -> E1 zone migration data exists.
